title: How do we find the corners of the equal rectangle?
description: A trapezium ABCD is turned into a rectangle EFGH of the same area. The corners come from the midpoints of the two slanting sides: lines at right angles to the bottom side through the midpoints meet the bottom side and the top side extended, and each corner triangle matches the gap above it.
teaching_notes: One idea: find the midpoints of the slanting sides, draw lines at right angles to the bottom side through them, and the four meeting points are the corners. Watch for students who draw the lines from the corners of the trapezium instead of from the midpoints.

source: Trapezium ABCD converted into a rectangle EFGH of equal area, with the hint on triangles AHI and DGI and triangles BEJ and CFJ
video_script.why: The child has cut a trapezium into a square and a triangle and now finds the corners of an equal rectangle from the midpoints of the slanting sides.
video_script.substitution: The book question gives no numbers, so the sides stay as letters.
video_script.anchor: the trapezium ABCD of the book with AB parallel to DC
video_script.payoff_line: The two lines through the midpoints cut D C and the line eigh B. The four cutting spots are the corners.

final_answer.value: E, F, G and H are where the lines at right angles to DC through I and J meet DC and the line AB
final_answer.spoken: the four corners are where the two lines through the midpoints cut the bottom side and the line of the top side

hold_back: meet DC and the line AB
maths_rules: trapezium ABCD with AB parallel to DC
I is the midpoint of AD and J is the midpoint of BC
the line through I at right angles to DC meets DC at G and the line AB extended at H
the line through J at right angles to DC meets DC at F and the line AB extended at E
AI = DI, the angles at H and G are right angles and the angles at I are vertically opposite, so triangle AHI and triangle DGI match
in the same way triangle BEJ and triangle CFJ match, so rectangle EFGH has the area of the trapezium
video_script.design: One trapezium ABCD stays all video. Lines at right angles to DC through the midpoints I and J cut it, and the corner triangles turn about the midpoints into the gaps. The meeting points are named E, F, G and H.
